description: Cryptographic and provenance inventory of research datasets and sources for KIIFB Dashboard

sources.title: Report of the Committee on A Comprehensive Review of Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (Official Combined PDF)
sources.publisher: Kerala Legislative Assembly (Niyamasabha) / Government of Keralam
sources.author: Sudha Pillai (Chairperson), Shyam Srinivasan, H. Shubhalakshmi Narayanan, Nilesh Vikamsey, Tarun Bajaj
sources.reporting_period: Up to June 30, 2026 (with selected tables to Sept 2026)
sources.notes: Full official combined PDF report tabled in Kerala Legislative Assembly. Includes signed transmittal letter, chapters I-VI, and official tables 3.1 to 6.3.

sources.title: Report of the Committee on A Comprehensive Review of Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (Markdown Extract)
sources.publisher: Committee for Restructuring of KIIFB / Government of Keralam
sources.author: Sudha Pillai (Chairperson), Shyam Srinivasan, H. Shubhalakshmi Narayanan, Nilesh Vikamsey, Tarun Bajaj
sources.notes: Pre-existing 2,400-line markdown transcription of full report including transmittal letter, foreword, chapters I-VI, and Tables 3.1 to 4.4.

sources.title: KIIFB Official Project Status Database (Live Register)
sources.notes: Live interactive project status database containing 1,408 project rows across 35 government departments, including approved amount, payment released, SPV, and official status.

sources.title: KITE Sametham — KIIFB Funded Schools Directory
sources.publisher: Kerala Infrastructure and Technology for Education (KITE) / General Education Department
sources.notes: Authentic directory of 969 KIIFB-funded public schools across all 14 districts, with official school codes (HS/HSE/VHSE), school names, and assembly constituency mappings.
